name: token-optimiser
description: Spend fewer tokens for the same work: the model follows the job (a cheaper one for lookups and subagents, the strong one for design), and tool output, edits and searches are kept small. A /tokens report shows what it did

route.title: Route models by the job
route.description: Choose the main loop's model from each prompt (read by the light model, by rules when that fails) and each subagent's model from its type. A model you pick with /model is left alone for the rest of the session

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Full model id for lookups and mechanical requests in the main loop (an alias such as haiku is refused there). It also reads each prompt to choose the tier

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Full model id for ordinary work in the main loop

heavyModel.title: Heavy model
heavyModel.description: Full model id for design, root-cause and multi-file work in the main loop

holdHeavyAtPercent.title: Hold heavy work at (% of the 7-day limit)
holdHeavyAtPercent.description: On a plan login, once this much of the 7-day limit is used, heavy work runs on the standard model

lightOnlyAtPercent.title: Light only at (% of the 7-day limit)
lightOnlyAtPercent.description: On a plan login, once this much of the 7-day limit is used, everything runs on the light model

handPickPrompts.title: Prompts a hand-picked model is kept
handPickPrompts.description: After you change model with /model, routing leaves it alone for this many prompts, then resumes

subagentTiers.title: Subagent tiers
subagentTiers.description: JSON object of agent type to light, standard or heavy, replacing the built-in table ({"Explore":"light","general-purpose":"standard","Plan":"heavy"}). A plugin's agent matches by its bare name too. An agent not listed keeps its own model

diagnostics.title: Check files after each edit
diagnostics.description: After Edit, Write or HashEdit, run a fast checker for the file type (ruff for Python syntax and undefined names, bash -n, JSON parse) and hand Claude any errors

advisorModel.title: Advisor model
advisorModel.description: A second model (an alias such as opus or sonnet, or a full id) that reviews each finished turn and hands the agent a concern or blocker before it stops. Costs one extra request per turn. Empty turns the advisor off

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON array of pattern rules applied to every tool call (a project's .claude/token-optimiser-rules.json is read too). Empty: project rules only

trimChars.title: Trim output over (characters)
trimChars.description: Bash output longer than this keeps its head and tail; the full text is saved to a file

protectBranch.title: Protected branch
protectBranch.description: Refuse git pushes to this branch (for example main, where a push deploys). Empty turns the guard off

pushNote.title: Why the branch is protected
pushNote.description: Shown to Claude when a push is refused, for example: a push to main deploys

mountGuardPath.title: Compose folder to guard
mountGuardPath.description: Refuse single-file bind mounts in YAML files whose path contains this, for example deploy/compose/. Empty turns the guard off
